notes.title: Exciting New Update for Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense!
notes.content:
Hello Defenders!

We are thrilled to announce that a new update for [u]Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense[/u] is now live! This update brings several exciting features and enhancements that will improve your gaming experience and introduce new challenges. Here’s what’s new:
[h2]1. Global Leaderboard[/h2]
Compete with players around the world and climb the ranks! See how you stack up against the best defenders and strive to secure your spot at the top.
[h2]2. Four New Maps/Environments[/h2][list]    [*][u]Winter Wonderland[/u]: Chill and defend in the frosty tundra.[/*]    [*][u]Lush Forest[/u]: Keep the enemies at bay in a vibrant and dense forest.[/*]    [*][u]Scorching Desert[/u]: Withstand the heat and your foes in a vast desert.[/*]    [*][u]Autumn Retreat[/u]: Experience the serene beauty and the fall of leaves mixed with the thrill of defense.[/*][/list][h2]3. Enhanced Camera Controls[/h2][list]    [*][u]Dual Camera Views[/u]: Switch between two different camera views for better control and strategy planning.[/*]    [*][u]Zoom In-Out[/u]: Get a closer look or a wider view of the battlefield with our new zoom functionality.[/*]    [*][u]Drag Map View[/u]: Hold the right click to drag the map view, enhancing your navigation and control over the game environment.[/*][/list][h2]4. Speed Up Button[/h2]
Now, you can speed up the action during attacks! This new feature allows you to accelerate gameplay, making those intense moments even more thrilling.

These updates are designed to enrich your gameplay and provide you with more tools to defend against the invasion. We can’t wait to see how these changes will impact your strategies and gameplay.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We're excited to see all the new heights you will reach with these updates. As always, we welcome your feedback and would love to hear your thoughts on these new features.

Happy defending!

[b]The Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense Dev[/b]

notes.title: Exciting News for Mac Defenders: Installation Error Fixed!
notes.content:
Greetings, Mighty Defenders,

I come bearing fantastic news from the battlefront! It's been brought to our attention that some of our valiant Mac users encountered a pesky installation error recently. But fear not, for our team has rallied together to vanquish this foe and ensure your path to defending our realm remains unimpeded!

To harness the power of this newfound victory, I call upon you to embark on a noble quest: uninstall the game from your arsenal and reinstall it once more. With this simple maneuver, you'll be poised to reclaim your rightful place as defenders of our beloved planet.

Your unwavering commitment to repelling the onslaught of invaders has been a beacon of hope in our darkest hours. As a solo game dev, I am deeply grateful for your steadfast support and unwavering dedication to our cause.

Let us march forward, united in our quest to safeguard our world from the clutches of tyranny!

Until victory is ours,

Jorge
Guardian of "Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense"

notes.title: Bug Fix Update: Game Over Restart Issue Resolved
notes.content:
Hello Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense Players!

I have an important update for you. As a solo game developer, your feedback is invaluable to me, and I'm excited to share that I’ve fixed a pesky bug that some of you reported.

Previously, there was an issue during the Game Over sequence where players were unable to restart the game and continue playing. I understand how frustrating this interruption can be, and I truly appreciate your patience as I worked to resolve the problem.

I’m happy to announce that this issue has now been fixed! You should be able to restart and continue your adventure in Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense seamlessly.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. I'm committed to providing you with the best gaming experience possible, and I appreciate your help in identifying and fixing bugs.

As always, if you encounter any further issues or have any suggestions, please don’t hesitate to reach out through the community forums or directly to me.

Happy gaming!

Jorge
Developer of Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense

notes.title: Update notes for May 13
notes.content:
Greetings, Valiant Defenders!

We are thrilled to see you standing strong against the onslaught in "Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense". Your unwavering courage and strategic prowess are what make our game truly special!

In the spirit of ever-evolving gameplay and continuous improvement, we are excited to announce the latest update that brings not only fixes but also a fresh, frosty feel to your battles.

[list]
[*] Winter Wonderland: As the seasons change in the real world, so do they in our game. Several levels have been transformed into a winter wonderland, adding a new layer of environmental strategy to your defense planning.
[*] Level 50 Laser Fix: We've addressed an issue that some of you experienced at the pivotal Level 50. The laser installation glitch has now been rectified, ensuring smooth and efficient tower upgrades when you need them the most.
[*] Starting Coins Boost: We understand that every coin counts when you're fending off waves of enemies. So, from now on, if your coin count dips below 100, we'll boost it back up to 100 every time you enter play mode. This way, you're always ready for the next wave, no matter what.
[*] Enemy Bounty Increase: We've heard your strategic discussions and agree that every vanquished enemy should feel like a victory. To make each defeat of your foes even more rewarding, we're increasing the bounty you receive from each enemy you destroy. This means more resources for your defenses, and more satisfaction from each victorious battle.
[/list]

As always, we are deeply grateful for your support and feedback. Our mission is to provide you with the best tower defense experience possible, and your input helps us do just that.

Stay strong, Defenders. The battle is far from over!

Best,
Jorge

notes.title: New Heights: 'Invasion' Update & Features
notes.content:
Greetings, Valiant Defenders!

I'm excited to bring you the latest update for "Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense". As a solo developer, your feedback and gaming experience are incredibly important to me.

In this new patch, I've focused on enhancing the experience for those of you who have bravely crossed the Level 50 threshold. I've worked hard to squash several pesky bugs that were impacting gameplay for our high-level players. Your smooth and immersive gaming experience is my top priority, and I believe this update will make your battles even more enjoyable.

Moreover, I'm introducing a new feature that I hope will enrich your strategic planning. Now, whenever you unlock a new enemy or tower, a detailed information screen will appear. This will provide you with insightful data about your new acquisition, helping you to optimize your defenses or understand your enemies better. Remember, knowledge is power!

As always, I'm committed to continually improving "Invasion, Tales of Tower Defense". Your feedback is invaluable in this process, so please don't hesitate to share your thoughts on these updates, and let me know if there's anything else you'd like to see in the game.

Stand strong, Defenders. The battle continues!

Best,
Jorge

notes.title: April updates!
notes.content:
Greetings, Defenders!

We're excited to unveil the latest update for "Invasion: Tales of Tower Defense"! Our team has been hard at work refining your gameplay experience to make defending against the invasion even more seamless and enjoyable. Here's what's new:

Simplified Gameplay: We've listened to your feedback and have streamlined the game interface by removing unnecessary screens, allowing you to dive straight into the action without any distractions. Now, it's all about defending your towers against the relentless onslaught of invaders!

Start Game from Zero Button: Ever wanted a fresh start without the hassle of navigating through menus? Well, now you can! Introducing the "Start Game from Zero" button, giving you the power to begin anew with just one click. Whether you're a seasoned strategist or a rookie defender, every battle starts with a clean slate.

Achievement Unlocked Screens: We believe in celebrating your victories, big or small. With our new achievement unlocked screens, you'll be able to bask in the glory of your conquests as you progress through the game. Defend your towers with skill and style, and watch as your achievements light up the screen!

This update is all about enhancing your tower defense experience and putting the focus where it belongs: on the thrilling battles that await you. We hope you enjoy these improvements as much as we enjoyed bringing them to you.

As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. Feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions in the comments below or join our community forums to connect with fellow defenders.

Keep those towers standing tall!

Best regards,
Jorge

notes.title: New Multi-language system! available in English, Chinese, Russian and Spanish
notes.content: Invasion: Tales of Tower Defense welcomes the much-awaited Multi-language System! Engage in epic battles and strategize in your preferred language as we introduce support for English, Chinese, Russian, and Spanish.

notes.title: Update notes for Feb 25
notes.content:
[b]🌟 Introducing "Play as Guest" Feature! 🎮[/b]

Now, enjoy the game hassle-free with our new "Play as Guest" option! No need to sign in – just hit the button and dive straight into the action. Whether you're a first-time player or a seasoned strategist, experience the excitement without the login process. Your journey starts at level 1 when playing as a guest for the first time. Embark on your adventure and conquer the challenges effortlessly!

Thank you for your continued support. Happy gaming! 🚀✨
